heroHeadline: Ukraine Drones Strike Volgograd Lukoil Refinery; Sweden Donates 16 Gripen Jets in $2.7B Package; Russia Escalates to 267 Attacks and 269 Guided Bombs
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,555, Ukrainian long-range drones struck the Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka refinery overnight, setting it ablaze — continuing Ukraine's sustained campaign against Russian oil infrastructure. A nationwide air raid alert was declared as a Russian MiG-31K Kinzhal carrier took off. Russia escalated to 267 combat attacks and dropped 269 guided aerial bombs in a single day, with the Pokrovsk and Huliaipole sectors facing the heaviest pressure. On Day 1,554 (May 28), Swedish PM Ulf Kristersson visited Kyiv and announced the largest Swedish aid package of the war: 16 Gripen C/D jets donated plus an option for 20 new Gripen E jets, totalling ~$2.7 billion including $400M for Ukrainian drone production. Russian MLRS struck a Kherson playground on May 28, killing a father and critically wounding his 3-year-old daughter. ISW assessed that Putin is operating on falsified battlefield maps and has a false perception of Russian military success; Russia is reinforcing Moscow air defenses against Ukraine's growing deep-strike drone campaign. Russian cumulative losses reached ~1,360,110 personnel as of May 28 (~1,160/day). Peace talks remain stalled as Russia demands full Donetsk Oblast recognition and Ukraine rejects any territorial concessions.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, Ukrainska Pravda, Defense News, Euronews, Euromaidan Press, Soufan Center, Meduza, United24 Media, RBC Ukraine, and the Ukrainian General Staff. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
